discription: A simple bell-like sound generated by combining two sine waves with different decay envelopes to create a metallic timbre.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, bright=0.5; var sig1, sig2, env1, env2; env1 = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.001, 0.1, 0.5, 1.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); env2 = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.001, 0.05, 0.3, 0.8, curve: -4), gate: gate); sig1 = SinOsc.ar(freq) * env1; sig2 = (SinOsc.ar(freq * 2.005) + SinOsc.ar(freq * 3.001)) * env2 * bright; Out.ar(out, (sig1 + sig2) * amp ! 2); }
